paragraphs: Mentioned in [Shabbat 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.20b.8) and [33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.33b.4), and [Yevamot 97a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.97a.1). [Vayikra Rabbah 31:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.31.9) has R' Hoshaya, son of R' Shamlai, speaking in his name. Hyman cites Yalkut Tehillim, chapter 19, at the supplied locator תרע״נ, for R' Yehoshua speaking in the name of R' Yitzchak son of R' Zeira.[^1]

notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=374) gives Yehoshua and the supplied remez. The matching [Yalkut passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.673.4) has Hoshaya, as does Vayikra Rabbah. Shabbat and Yevamot vary between Yitzchak bar Zeira, bar Zeiri, and ben Zeira; the latter two also give Shimon Nezira as an alternative speaker for their respective verse questions.
